decisions.reason: The LED track spotlight line is core to the firm's modular track system, was still presented on its own page, and costs little to keep within a broad range, so the option stays open while its value keeps revealing itself.
The LED ceiling luminaire is a recent core line with no evidence of failure, and keeping it in the catalogue is cheap, so abandoning it would give up remaining upside for little saving.
The flexible LED spotlight was launched only in 2024 and has its own page, so its prospects remain uncertain and the low holding cost justifies keeping the option alive.
The multi-outlet ceiling canopy is a complementary system component that supports sales of the firm's pendants, so it costs little to keep and adds value across the range.
The low-voltage multi-outlet canopy extends the low-voltage system offer, is too new to judge, and keeping it is inexpensive, so the option should stay open.

The round glass track luminaires are only mentioned rather than featured, which signals slightly weaker prominence, but after one year the uncertainty is still high and the holding cost low, so keeping is preferable.
